description: A platform admin can bootstrap an organization by sending a first-admin invite, and the invited admin activates via a one-time link instead of receiving a pre-created password.
steps: Create an organization shell and send a first-admin invite by email
Accept the invite via one-time link and set a password
Land the invited admin in the launch wizard instead of an empty dashboard

description: The launch wizard and master data model support organization, subdivision, and unit setup, with unit remaining the primary operational scope and subdivision staying optional.
steps: Persist organization core fields separately from optional requisites and documents
Create subdivisions with a typed subdivision model
Create units both under a subdivision and directly under an organization

description: Users, memberships, invites, and scoped grants are separate concepts, and access inherits downward from organization to subdivision to unit without a deny layer.
steps: Model user account, organization membership, and scoped grant separately
Support role templates and scopes for organization, subdivision, and unit
Track invite statuses draft, sent, opened, accepted, expired, and revoked

description: Contracts remain a Stage 03 routing prerequisite and constrain the contractor available to Stage 04 request flows.
steps: Implement contracts registry and contract status baseline
Keep contractor selection constrained by contract context
Expose the resulting routing master data to later request creation

description: Equipment, measuring instruments, and standards exist as separate registries instead of a single mega-form.
steps: Create equipment cards independently of metrology
Create measuring instrument cards as their own entity
Create standards as a standalone registry with reusable references

description: Metrology operations are journal-driven, and current status derives from the latest valid record instead of only denormalized dates.
steps: Store journals for measuring instruments and standards
Support many-to-many or reusable links between measuring instruments and standards
Derive operational status and next due date from journal history

description: Stage 03 keeps archive-only lifecycle rules, bounded dictionary assumptions, and canonical documentation synchronized with the implementation and proof bundle.
steps: Use archive instead of hard delete for core master-data entities
Keep dictionary scope bounded and explicitly document why slice-005 does not widen into standalone local-draft dictionary CRUD
Sync roadmap, PRD, architecture docs, and stage artifacts as decisions are implemented
